universe.selection: exact existing frozen universe: all 12 CPI and all 12 Employment Situation releases

mission: Measure defensible public point-in-time consensus coverage only. Do not compute surprises or market outcomes.
revision_context: Prior payroll revisions remain BLS first-release fields already preserved by the parent census and are not consensus-source fields.

accepted_source_classes.requirements: Publisher-hosted PDF/document; explicit event/fields; creation/modification or publication metadata provably before T0; provenance retained; current bytes hashed where retrievable.

Named wire/survey; explicit published time before T0; modification time or sequential pre-T0 wire history sufficient for auditability; event and field values explicit. Normalized evidence is allowed when provider raw GET is transport-blocked, but must be labelled normalized and hashed separately.
Snapshot/capture timestamp strictly before T0; content contains explicit event/field values and identifiable publisher/source.
Institutional article/research with exact publication timestamp and version/modification trail strictly before T0; explicit fields and source identity.

rejected_source_classes: current mutable historical calendar without forecast vintage
same-day date-only publication without trusted pre-T0 capture
later revision substituted for contemporaneous consensus
collection_rules: Process every frozen event; no omission based on source difficulty.
Preserve every qualifying consensus snapshot found; do not select the numerically convenient one.
Never average conflicting vendors or conflicting snapshots.
Store provider/vendor, publication timestamp, modification timestamp when available, T0, lead seconds, values, URL/document identity, evidence class and evidence hash/normalized hash.
If the same vendor changes consensus across pre-T0 snapshots, preserve each version and label SOURCE_CONFLICT or VERSION_SEQUENCE; do not decide which snapshot is canonical in this source census.
An event is source-complete if all four consensus fields are defensibly covered by one source snapshot or by explicitly labelled COMPLETE_MIXED_SOURCE evidence allowed under inherited rules.
next_gate: After all 24 events are adjudicated, issue source-coverage closeout. Any directional V0.3 test requires a separate pre-outcome activation freeze defining vendor/snapshot-selection semantics before opening outcomes.
